create_layer_drop_module_list: create a LayerDropModuleList with dropout probability p and a list of nn modules
iterate_layer_drop_module_list: iterate over a LayerDropModuleList to apply selected non-dropped layers to input tensor
review_layer_drop_module_list_init: review the LayerDropModuleList __init__ method to understand how dropout probability p is stored
review_layer_drop_module_list_iter: review the LayerDropModuleList __iter__ method to understand how layers are randomly dropped during training
test_layer_drop_module_list: test the LayerDropModuleList to verify layers are dropped with probability p during training but not during evaluation
